blind.description: A stylized fantasy crystal formation composed of a tall central faceted purple crystal surrounded by eight shorter, outwardly radiating crystal shards of varying heights. All the crystals emerge from an integrated base of dark grey, rounded rough stones that sits flat on the ground. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted highlights along the facet edges.
blind.from_above: Resembles a symmetrical purple starburst or stylized floral pattern, featuring a central hexagonal faceted crystal cap encircled by radially pointing smaller crystal tips embedded in a dark grey rocky perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall (about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide across the base.
